_comment: Test kit mailed to Stompa before every test (Messenger > Commando, via SPT's 'spt give'). Stompa loses the kit in each test raid, so every new kitId mails the whole kit; F4 in the menus resends it. Ghost/lab tests: lean (only what the test needs, presets with their magazine + one magazine of ammo). Normal raids without ghost (Stompa, 2026-10-16): a full META-style kit with plenty of magazines and ammo + the meds a raid needs. 'spt give' sends a template with a default preset as the whole preset (weapons with their magazine, armour with its plates); magazines and meds come one per count, ammo split into stacks. Template ids verified in the SPT 4.1.6 database (2026-10-19).
note: 1.1.0 release check 6 (rc-6: scaled skins baked with their full transform): lab only, ghost on. BEAR PMC (F3 PMC T1 or T3) in a Tiger T-shirt: shots on the shirt, then loot AUTOPSY torso.
